documents.title: YouTube Official Policy: Prioritizing Original Content on Shorts & YPP Inauthentic Content
documents.content: YouTube Shorts recommendation and YouTube Partner Program (YPP) enforcement update effective 2026-10-01 prioritizes genuinely transformative original Shorts and demotes mass-produced unoriginal re-uploads (-40% to -80% reach reduction). Under the Inauthentic Content (formerly Repetitious Content) and Reused Content guidelines, channel-wide review disqualifies channels that upload raw third-party stream or podcast clips with only automated subtitles, static templates, or synthetic narration merely describing on-screen events—even with creator permission. Transformative eligibility requires substantive creative direction: curated reactive framing, non-duplicative editorial motion callouts (cover hook != interior overlay), motivated pacing cuts preserving emotional beats, clean audio mastering, and strict separation between CPM Bounty distribution accounts (voice_mode='none') and Owned YPP AdSense channels (human_batch editorial commentary).

documents.title: How YouTube Recommendations Work: Candidate Generation, Example Age & Satisfaction Signals
documents.content: YouTube Discovery operates as a viewer-pull multi-stage system decoupled between Shorts and Long-Form surfaces, bridged via the native Related Video link. Stage 1 Candidate Generation retrieves hundreds of candidates using Two-Tower co-visitation embeddings and explicit Example Age freshness features that boost newly published videos within 2-6 hours of a live cultural event. Stage 2 Multitask Ranking (MMoE + Shallow Tower position debiasing) balances immediate engagement (Viewed vs. Swiped Away >= 70%, Average Percentage Viewed >= 100% on 20-45s clips) with long-term viewer satisfaction surveys and session return rewards. Since 2026-06-25, explicit negative signals ('Don't recommend channel', rapid <1.5s swipes, early dislikes) carry severe multiplicative demotion against misleading clickbait or repetitive templates.

documents.title: YouTube Shorts Analytics: Public Views vs. Engaged Views Attribution
documents.content: YouTube separates Public Views (counted from Frame 0 playback or loop start) from Engaged Views (viewers who actively choose to continue watching past the initial swipe window without artificial loop manipulation). YPP eligibility thresholds (10M Shorts Engaged Views in 90 days), Shorts Creator Pool revenue sharing, and verified partner analytics strictly audit Engaged Views rather than raw Frame-0 impressions. Optimal 20-45s vertical narrative arcs maximize both Viewed vs. Swiped Away (VVSA >= 72%) and Engaged Views conversion while avoiding bot-traffic invalidation.

documents.title: YouTube Policy: Disclosing Altered or Synthetic Content (AIGC)
documents.content: Creators must disclose meaningfully altered or synthetic media in YouTube Studio when realistic human likenesses, cloned voices, or fabricated real-world events could mislead viewers. Standard editorial color grading, background matting, noise reduction, auto-captions, and animated graphic callouts do NOT require synthetic content disclosure. Undisclosed voice cloning of real creators risks label enforcement, demonetization, or removal; keeping authentic creator audio (voice_mode='none') on stream clips avoids synthetic likeness violations.

documents.title: Documentación Oficial YouTube Shorts 2026: Originalidad, Vistas con Interacción y Contenido Inauténtico
documents.content: Las políticas oficiales de YouTube Shorts (actualización 2026-10-01) priorizan contenido original transformativo y reducen entre 40% y 80% el alcance de recortes masivos sin edición creativa real. El Programa de Socios de YouTube (YPP) evalúa el canal completo bajo Contenido Reutilizado e Inauténtico, contabilizando únicamente Vistas con Interacción (Engaged Views) reales y penalizando señales negativas tempranas ('No recomendar canal' y deslizamientos en menos de 1.5s). Para máxima retención, sostener VVSA >= 70%, evitar duplicar el titular de portada en el overlay interno y usar el enlace de Video Relacionado hacia compilaciones editoriales 16:9 de más de 8 minutos.

documents.title: Meta AI System Cards: Instagram Reels Chaining, Explore & Feed Multimodal Ranking
documents.content: Meta AI System Cards document distinct 4-stage recommendation pipelines across Instagram Reels Chaining, Explore, and Feed powered by the Andromeda dense multimodal retriever and GEM/Lattice rankers. In Reels Chaining: (1) Candidate Retrieval gathers connected and unconnected reels; (2) Integrity & Originality Filtering removes policy-violating, watermarked, or duplicate-frame clips; (3) Lightweight Shortlisting narrows to ~100 candidates; (4) Heavy Multitask Ranking scores predicted probabilities of watching >95% of duration, skipping in <3 seconds (primary negative gate), resharing via DM (Sends Per Reach—top unconnected growth signal), saving, and UTIS user-satisfaction survey alignment. Explore retrieves ~1,500 candidates via Two-Tower neural networks down to 100 before multi-task ranking.

documents.title: Instagram Originality Score, Aggregator Rule (10-in-30-Days), Trial Reels & Account Status
documents.content: Instagram Account Status enforces strict Originality Score checks: accounts posting 10 or more unoriginal/reposted videos without material creative transformation within a rolling 30-day window lose recommendation eligibility across Reels, Explore, and Suggested Feed entirely. Andromeda perceptual frame indexing (updated 2026-10-28) detects identical visual templates and third-party watermarks. Trial Reels allow cold-audience testing (24-72h to non-followers) of distinct 0-3s hook variants (--ab-variants 2) without penalizing main grid followers, provided identical MP4 binaries are never re-uploaded repeatedly. Limit captions to <=5 relevant hashtags.

documents.title: Tarjetas de Sistema Meta AI e Instagram Reels 2026: Originalidad, Sends Per Reach y Trial Reels
documents.content: El sistema Reels Chaining de Meta AI (Andromeda + GEM) filtra candidatos en cuatro etapas y pondera como señal número uno de alcance no conectado los envíos por mensaje directo (Sends Per Reach), junto con retención superior al 95% y baja tasa de salto en los primeros 3 segundos (3s Skip Rate). Publicar 10 o más clips no originales en 30 días expulsa a la cuenta completa de Recomendaciones y Explorar. Usar Trial Reels con variantes reales de gancho 0-3s, cero marcas de agua externas y máximo 5 hashtags.

documents.title: TikTok Official: How TikTok Recommends Videos #ForYou & Real-Time Streaming Ranking
documents.content: TikTok #ForYou recommendations evaluate each upload in progressive exposure batches starting with a 200-500 impression seed cohort, updating collisionless embeddings in minutes via streaming online training (ByteDance Monolith). For 25-60s clips, promotion to 10K+ cohorts depends on >=70% 3-second hold, >=18-25s absolute average watch time, >=1% share rate, and >=2% save rate. TikTok Search SEO indexes four signals simultaneously: spoken ASR words, 0-3s on-screen OCR text, natural caption phrasing, and high-intent comment keywords.

documents.title: TikTok Creator Academy: FYF Originality Eligibility, C2PA Content Credentials & Likeness Detection
documents.content: TikTok For You Feed (FYF) eligibility screens every video pre-distribution using visual perceptual hashing (pHash), audio fingerprinting, and 0-7.5s OCR/ASR safety scanning. Unedited clips, mirrored/lightly zoomed re-uploads, watermarked exports, or visible/audible profanity in the opening 0-7.5s are marked 'Ineligible for the For You Feed'. Effective 2026-11-20, TikTok (a C2PA Steering Committee member) reads inbound C2PA Content Credentials and runs Likeness Detection to auto-label or demonetize undisclosed AI voice/face clones. Keep authentic human speech (voice_mode='none' on bounties) and censor profanity in 0-7.5s across both audio and burned captions.

documents.title: TikTok Creator Academy 2026: Elegibilidad Para Ti (FYF), SEO Cuádruple y C2PA
documents.content: TikTok evalúa cada video en lotes semilla de 200-500 vistas exigiendo retención de 3 segundos >= 70%, tiempo visto absoluto >= 18-25s y transformación visual real frente a filtros pHash y huella de audio. Cualquier grosería audible o visible por OCR entre 0 y 7.5 segundos bloquea el feed Para Ti (FYF). Desde noviembre de 2026, TikTok audita metadatos C2PA y detección de clonación de voz/rostro (Likeness Detection), por lo que en campañas CPM debe preservarse la voz original sin TTS sintético no declarado.

documents.title: X (Twitter) Verified Source Architecture & Weights (xai-org/x-algorithm home-mixer Nov 2026)
documents.content: Verified directly from `xai-org/x-algorithm` Rust `home-mixer` (`params/param.rs`, `scoring.rs`, `scorers/author_cold_start.rs`, last sync 2026-11-20): Phoenix Transformer predicts personalized action probabilities weighted by `ShareViaCopyLinkWeight = +20.0` (#1 positive lever, 28.2x a Like), `ReplyWeight = +5.0` (+`BidirectionalFollowReplyWeightBoost = +15.0` -> `+20.0` when author/viewer mutually interact), `ShareViaDmWeight = +5.0`, `QuoteWeight = +5.0`, `FollowAuthorWeight = +4.0`, `ShareWeight = +2.118`, `RetweetWeight = +1.0`, `FavoriteWeight = +0.708`, and `ContClickDwellTimeWeight = +0.385`, while `ReportWeight = -234.0`, `MuteAuthorWeight = -58.8`, `NotInterestedWeight = -53.07`, and `BlockAuthorWeight = -31.2` crush rage-bait. Video & Cold-Start guards: `MinVideoDurationMs = 10000` (keep clips >= 12s for VQV credit); `ColdStartFollowerCap = 50000`, `ColdStartImpressionThreshold = 200`, `ColdStartMaxPostAgeSecs = 7200` (2h Thompson Sampling boost in slots 15-16); `VideoCarouselEmbeddingDedupe = 0.72` cosine threshold; `VideoCarouselFatigueMinutes = 60` (space uploads >= 3h apart; place external YouTube links strictly in reply, never in main post). Direct-URL engagement pods carry 0.0 ranking weight.

documents.title: Algoritmo Oficial de X (xai-org/x-algorithm Nov 2026): Pesos Reales de Ranking y Cold-Start
documents.content: Pesos verificados en `home-mixer/params/param.rs` de `xai-org/x-algorithm`: Copiar enlace (`ShareViaCopyLinkWeight = +20.0`), Respuesta con interacción mutua (`+20.0`), Compartir por DM (`+5.0`) y Citar (`+5.0`) dominan sobre el Like pasivo (`+0.708`), mientras que Reportar (`-234.0`), Silenciar (`-58.8`) y No me interesa (`-53.07`) destruyen el alcance. Todo video nativo en X debe durar al menos 12s (`MinVideoDurationMs = 10000`), mantener similitud coseno < 0.72 frente a resubidas crudas, espaciarse >= 3 horas (`VideoCarouselFatigueMinutes = 60`) y aprovechar las primeras 2 horas (`ColdStartMaxPostAgeSecs = 7200`) de exploración Thompson Sampling sin enlaces externos en el post principal.

documents.title: Whop Content Rewards Official Documentation: Eligibility, Payout Pool Velocity & Anti-Bot Rules
documents.content: Whop Content Rewards governs pay-per-1,000-views (CPM) clipping campaigns across YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels (Professional/Creator account required), and X. Eligibility requires verified 18+ account standing, KYC identity/tax verification prior to payout withdrawal, and strict compliance with each campaign's Offer Details (required hashtags, audio/official-sound policy, voiceover ban, and audience geo-lock). Submissions undergo seller review (typically 48h auto-approval window unless flagged) against funded escrow pools; operators should prioritize campaigns with 20%-80% budget burn rate and verified pool velocity. Whop's automated Bot Score (0-100) cross-checks native platform analytics to flag artificial view spikes, datacenter/proxy traffic, or engagement pods, resulting in immediate submission rejection, balance forfeiture, and permanent ban.

documents.title: Whop Content Rewards 2026 (Operación LATAM/Argentina): Elegibilidad CPM, Burn Rate y Reglas Anti-Bot
documents.content: Reglas operativas oficiales de Whop Content Rewards para estudios desde Argentina/LATAM: exigir edad >= 18 años con KYC verificado, seleccionar campañas con burn rate saludable entre 20% y 80% y priorizar campañas `global` o `latam` en YouTube Shorts y X por encima de campañas con geo-lock estricto `60% US` en TikTok/Instagram. Respetar siempre `voice_mode='none'` cuando el brief exige audio original del creador, evitar música con copyright salvo campañas `sound_campaign` sincronizadas in-app, y operar 100% con tráfico orgánico desde IP residencial limpia para mantener `Bot Score` en cero.

documents.title: Modern Short-Form RecSys Architecture: Candidate Generation -> Multitask Ranking -> Diversity Re-Ranking
documents.content: Industrial short-form video recommendation systems execute a strict 3-stage funnel: (1) Candidate Generation reduces tens of millions of videos to hundreds via Two-Tower dense embeddings (user history vs. multimodal audio/frame/ASR video embeddings) plus freshness priors (`Example Age`); (2) Fine Multitask Ranking (MMoE / Transformer) predicts calibrated per-user probabilities for positive high-effort actions (DM share, copy-link, save, rewatch, full completion) vs. negative gates (<3s swipe-away, hide, report), debiasing position with a shallow tower; (3) Re-Ranking enforces author diversity decay, perceptual/embedding deduplication (cosine >= 0.72 suppression), and session fatigue spacing. Packaging implication: clear topic entities in audio ASR + OCR + title align Two-Tower retrieval with the right seed audience, while the 0-3s hook and climax payoff win the MMoE ranker.

documents.title: Explore-Exploit Contextual Bandits & Cold-Start Mechanics Across Short-Form Platforms
documents.content: Every new upload enters an Explore-Exploit bandit phase (200-500 seed impressions on TikTok/Shorts; Thompson Sampling Beta(0.75, 49.25) for <200 impressions within 7,200s on X; 24-72h unconnected cohort on Instagram Trial Reels). During Exploration, uncertainty is high: ambiguous hooks or orphaned pronouns split viewer response and collapse posterior reward below the Exploitation threshold. Winning Cold-Start requires immediate visual clarity in <1.5s for strangers (`gate_alone`), niche consistency across channel uploads so collaborative-filtering user clusters converge fast, and publishing within 2-6 hours of trending events.

documents.title: Creator Insider Primary Talk: Shorts vs. Long-Form Discovery Decoupling & Viewer Satisfaction
documents.content: Distilled engineering Q&A from YouTube Discovery leads on Creator Insider: (1) Shorts feed history and Long-Form Home/Suggested models use separate candidate pools so an underperforming Short does not penalize Long-Form impressions on the same channel; (2) the native Related Video link on a Short transfers high-intent viewers directly into an 8+ minute Long-Form video when the Short resolves its own micro-promise while opening a broader thematic question; (3) Viewed vs. Swiped Away measures whether the opening 1-3 seconds matched viewer intent in the feed, whereas post-watch survey models penalize bait-and-switch endings.

documents.title: Creator Insider Primary Talk: Shorts Duration Buckets, Engaged Views & Originality Signals
documents.content: Distilled YouTube Shorts product & ranking guidance from Creator Insider: Shorts are compared against peer videos of similar duration buckets rather than a single flat percentage curve. Ultra-short clips (<15s) require >115% Average Percentage Viewed via seamless loops, whereas 25-50s narrative Shorts scale strongly at 85%-105% APV because absolute watch time and share/comment satisfaction are higher. Deleting and re-uploading an identical Short resets seed learning and triggers duplicate/unoriginal suppression; test creative variations via genuinely distinct 0-3s visual openings and complementary custom covers.

documents.title: Creator Insider Primary Talk: Exploration Seed Batches, Delayed Takeoffs & Negative Feedback
documents.content: Distilled Creator Insider Discovery Q&A: Shorts frequently display step-function trajectories—an initial 500-2,000 seed test followed by a pause while ranking models accumulate Engaged Views and satisfaction signals before unlocking broader cohorts. Rapid <1.5s swipes, 'Not interested', and 'Don't recommend channel' act as hard brakes on expansion. Consistent visual quality, clean -14 LUFS loudness without harsh clipping, and truthful curiosity-gap titles prevent negative feedback spikes.

documents.title: Software-Agnostic Short-Form Craft: 0-3s Triple Hook, Foreshadowing, But/Therefore, Comedy Timing & Outliers
documents.content: Universal software-agnostic short-form retention principles across gaming, podcasts, stand-up comedy, talks, AI news, animation, and cinema essays: (1) 0-3s Triple Hook aligns mute-readable visual motion, spoken stakes without orphaned pronouns, and a concise complementary pattern-interrupt headline; (2) Causal 'But / Therefore' progression replaces flat 'And then' chronology so every 5-8s beat escalates conflict or reverses expectation (foreshadowing stakes early without spoiling the climax); (3) High-arousal STEPPS share triggers (awe, explosive laughter, shocking skill/physics reversal, practical insight) drive DM Sends and Copy-Link shares; (4) Genre-specific pause discipline: trim dead air aggressively in AI news, moderately in podcasts/gaming (preserving 0.25s Synchresis pre-impact silence), and NEVER chop comedic pre-punchline pauses, room laughter release, or animated visual choreography; (5) Outlier benchmarking evaluates candidate topics by Views- Divided-By-Channel-Median (>=3.0x outlier ratio) rather than raw subscriber-inflated view counts.

documents.title: Craft Universal de Retención Multi-Nicho: Gancho 0-3s, Causalidad Pero/Por Tanto, Pausas de Comedia y Outliers
documents.content: Principios universales de retención agnósticos de software para gaming, podcasts, stand-up comedy, charlas, noticias de IA, animación y cine/series: (1) Triple Gancho 0-3s alineando acción visual legible en silencio, premisa hablada sin pronombres huérfanos y titular complementario; (2) Narrativa causal 'Pero / Por lo tanto' (But/Therefore) con preanuncio de riesgo (foreshadowing) en lugar de secuencias planas 'Y después'; (3) Activación emocional alta (asombro, risa genuina, giro inesperado de valencia) para disparar envíos por DM y copia de enlace; (4) Respeto estricto del ritmo por nicho: recorte ágil en noticias de IA, moderado en entrevistas/gaming (preservando 0.25s de Synchresis), y preservación íntegra de silencios previos al remate y risas de sala en stand-up comedy o animación; (5) Selección de temas por ratio Outlier (>= 3.0x sobre la mediana del canal).
